name: Nerja
title: Holidays in Nerja
intro: A whitewashed Costa del Sol town on low cliffs, with sandy coves, a giant cave and the mountain village of Frigiliana close by. Here's what Nerja is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: The Balcón de Europa in Nerja, a clifftop promenade above small coves
facts_note: The EU is bringing in new entry checks, so check the rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: April to June and September to October are best, warm and sunny with a pleasant sea in autumn. July and August are hot and busy. Winter is mild and sunny, around 17 to 18°C, which makes Nerja a popular winter sun spot.

things.name: Balcón de Europa
things.blurb: A palm-lined clifftop promenade looking along the coast.

things.name: Nerja Caves
things.blurb: Huge caverns with one of the world's largest stalactite columns.

things.name: Burriana beach
things.blurb: The town's main sandy beach, with paella cooked over wood fires.

things.name: Río Chíllar
things.blurb: Wade up a river through a narrow gorge. Wear shoes you can get wet.

things.name: Frigiliana
things.blurb: One of Andalucía's prettiest white villages, 15 minutes inland.

things.name: Kayak to Maro cliffs
things.blurb: Paddle to a waterfall that falls straight into the sea.

faqs.question: Is Nerja worth visiting?
faqs.answer: Yes. It's one of the prettiest towns on the Costa del Sol, with a real old town, small beaches and no high-rise hotels.

faqs.question: How long is the flight to Nerja from the UK?
faqs.answer: About 2 hours 45 minutes to Málaga, then about an hour by bus or car to Nerja.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Nerja?
faqs.answer: April to June and September to October, around 22 to 28°C. Winter is mild enough for walks in the sun.

faqs.question: How many nights do you need in Nerja?
faqs.answer: A week gives time for the beaches, the caves, Frigiliana and the river walk.

faqs.question: Is Nerja good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. Burriana beach has calm water and play areas, and the caves and river walk are popular with children.
